theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case red_I x =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨x, .refl x, .red_I x⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par c d hc hd => cases hc; exact ⟨d, hd, .red_I d⟩
  case red_K x y =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨x, .refl x, .red_K x y⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par c d hc hd =>
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible x c hc
      exact ⟨z, hz, .red_K z d⟩
  case red_S x y z =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨x ⬝ z ⬝ (y ⬝ z), .refl _, .red_S x y z⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par c d hc hd =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible x y c hc
      exact ⟨u ⬝ d ⬝ (v ⬝ d), .par (.par hu hd) (.par hv hd), .red_S u v d⟩
  case par p q r s hp hq ip iq =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨q ⬝ s, .refl _, .par hp hq⟩
    case par c d hc hd =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := ip hc
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := iq hd
      exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
    case red_I => cases hp; exact ⟨s, .red_I s, hq⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ q hp
      exact ⟨z, .red_K z s, hz⟩
    case red_S x y =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible x y q hp
      exact ⟨u ⬝ s ⬝ (v ⬝ s), .red_S u v s, .par (.par hu hq) (.par hv hq)⟩
